history.headline: Four decades scaling with process industry.
paragraphs: Toromac was founded in 1985 as a workshop building equipment for the food industry. Four decades later, we still operate the same way: in-house engineering, manufacturing under our own roof, and direct technical contact between customer and plant.
What's changed is volume, sectors and regulations. Today we build for plants moving thousands of tonnes per year, with certified sanitary finishes and ATEX options for explosion-risk environments.

What hasn't changed is how we work. Every machine is designed around the product it will handle, not around a closed catalog. There's no line between sales and engineering: the person presenting the unit is the one who signs the drawing.

why.headline: Technical differences that matter on the floor.

items.title: In-house design and manufacturing
items.body: We don't integrate third-party equipment. Every elevator, conveyor and sifter is designed and built in our facility. That means full control of tolerances, materials and lead times — no external dependencies.

items.title: Process engineering, not sales
items.body: Your first contact is an engineer, not a salesperson. We'll ask about product, granulometry, density, capacity and applicable standards — because that's where a correct unit begins.

items.title: Certified sanitary finishes
items.body: Stainless steel 304L or 316L per sector requirement. Polished welds, no-retention geometries and hygienic-handling options for food and pharma. ATEX on demand for chemical.

items.title: Auditable lead times
items.body: We commit to a delivery date in the quote and we hit it. If a technical issue arises, we call you before it affects your planning. No silent overruns, no excuses.

sectors.headline: Specific engineering for each industry.
sectors.lead: The rules for an extruded cereal, a powdered active ingredient and a chemical granulate are different. We design knowing the sector — not adapting a generic.

items.title: Product overrides catalog
items.body: If the product to handle requires geometry, speed or material outside the catalog, we build it. The catalog is a starting point, not a destination.

items.title: Traceability is not optional
items.body: Every unit ships with its documentation: material certificates, as-built drawings, FAT when applicable, manuals in customer language. Validation is part of the product.

items.title: After-sales is engineering, not call centre
items.body: If you need spare parts, modifications or technical advice, the engineer who knows your installation will reply. No queues, no scripted protocols.

ctaBand.headline: Project on your desk?
ctaBand.lead: Engineering team available to review specs, layout or equipment replacement. Reply within 48 working hours.
